raw_response:
The issuer shows critical liquidity weakness with a current ratio of 0.53 and negative working capital, indicating an inability to meet short-term obligations without external support. High leverage is evident with a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 2.67 and an estimated EBIT interest coverage ratio below 1, suggesting the company is vulnerable to default under current conditions. Despite positive retained earnings and an EBIT margin of 22.6%, these factors are insufficient to offset the severe liquidity and leverage risks, placing the issuer in the CCC category due to its dependence on favorable conditions to avoid default.

DECISION: CCC
